local xLErbohdlN=(function()
  local _k={}
  for _,_p in ipairs({uWoilOByGYCYowm,manFGSNIyGFgxNbA,TbgsgshOVkOHXsKolT,qOKEyqAzGetaILirfDB}) do
    for _,_b in ipairs(_p) do _k[#_k+1]=_b end
  end
  return _k
end)()
local ylwzwiBBOa=#xLErbohdlN
local QBoTQqIiYGBitXP=function(_b,_i)
  return _b~xLErbohdlN[((_i-1)%ylwzwiBBOa)+1]~((sOqnaBvyrpu+_i)%256)
end
local vzFjKEbiNM=""
for KXGJxePlIRVGC=1,#kOQExucbZnqQIPEb do
  vzFjKEbiNM=vzFjKEbiNM..string.char(QBoTQqIiYGBitXP(kOQExucbZnqQIPEb[KXGJxePlIRVGC],KXGJxePlIRVGC))

-- Decompress
local jMAYZDuAJrRyKyGL=(function()
  if zlib then return zlib end
  local ok,lib=pcall(require,"zlib")
  if ok then return lib end
  return nil
end)()
local AnifJdTKBGZOvBeQQRS
if jMAYZDuAJrRyKyGL and jMAYZDuAJrRyKyGL.inflate then
  AnifJdTKBGZOvBeQQRS=jMAYZDuAJrRyKyGL.inflate()(vzFjKEbiNM)
elseif jMAYZDuAJrRyKyGL and jMAYZDuAJrRyKyGL.decompress then
  AnifJdTKBGZOvBeQQRS=jMAYZDuAJrRyKyGL.decompress(vzFjKEbiNM)
else
  -- Fallback: payload was not compressed (plain path)
  AnifJdTKBGZOvBeQQRS=vzFjKEbiNM
end
local xqOXyOBcfpogkbhTBQf=setmetatable({},{__index=_G})
local bUsVwjsCvHoIFNkY,vgQFLOavDZTWQbYVGU=load(AnifJdTKBGZOvBeQQRS,nil,"t",xqOXyOBcfpogkbhTBQf)
if not bUsVwjsCvHoIFNkY then
  -- zlib not available, try raw (non-compressed fallback)
  bUsVwjsCvHoIFNkY,vgQFLOavDZTWQbYVGU=load(vzFjKEbiNM,nil,"t",xqOXyOBcfpogkbhTBQf)
end
if not bUsVwjsCvHoIFNkY then error("LuaShield: "..tostring(vgQFLOavDZTWQbYVGU),0) end
